gloss: to be appalled; to be exasperated; to be dumbfounded

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {呆|あき}れていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be appalled; to be exasperated; to be dumbfounded
definitions.explanation: Expresses negative surprise - disappointment, disgust, or exasperation at behavior or a situation that defies common sense. Not used for positive amazement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{無責任|むせきにん}さ→無責任：13474_musekinin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{呆|あき}れた。
examples.english: I was appalled by his irresponsibility.

examples.japanese: {呆|あき}れて⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{言|い}えなかった→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I was so dumbfounded I couldn't say anything.

examples.japanese: {呆|あき}れる⟦ほど→ほど：01724_hodo⟧⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦だった→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: It was an appallingly rude attitude.

notes:
FORMS:
- {呆|あき}れる → {呆|あき}れない (negative)
- {呆|あき}れる → {呆|あき}れて (te-form)
- {呆|あき}れる → {呆|あき}れた (past)
- {呆|あき}れる → {呆|あき}れれば (conditional)

WRITING:
Alternative kanji: ⟦{惘|あき}れる→惘れる：noentry⟧ (less common)

USAGE:
Usually expresses negative surprise - disappointment, disgust, or exasperation at someone's behavior or a situation that defies common sense.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{呆|あき}れる (to be appalled at ~)
- {呆|あき}れて⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{言|い}えない→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to be speechless with amazement)
- {呆|あき}れる⟦ほど→ほど：01724_hodo⟧ (appallingly, to an astonishing degree)
- {呆|あき}れ⟦{顔|がお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (look of disbelief)
- {呆|あき}れ⟦{果|は}てる→果てる：28565_hateru⟧ (to be utterly appalled - intensified form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{驚|おどろ}く→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧ - to be surprised (neutral)
- ⟦{唖然|あぜん}→唖然：09404_azen⟧⟦とする→する：00392_suru⟧ - to be stunned, dumbfounded
- ⟦{愕然|がくぜん}→愕然：08682_gakuzen⟧⟦とする→する：00392_suru⟧ - to be shocked
